script.base: Market prices a close dome game, SF 26.0 to ARI 22.5, not a blowout. SF leans on Christian McCaffrey (weeks 8-10: 48 car/161 rush, 22 tgt/176 rec) with Brian Robinson as the changeup (13/94). ARI, with Marvin Harrison Jr. out, funnels throws to Trey McBride (weeks 7/9/10: 35 tgt/256 yds/269 air) and Michael Wilson (15/135/120) while Bam Knight (33/112) shares a battered line. Pace stays two-dimensional; 48.5 and a closed roof do not drag volume.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both overs lost because San Francisco led early, Arizona's line without Jonah Williams and Hayden Conner could not protect, and Brissett's checkdowns went to the backs while McBride was bracketed into another 55-yard day and Wilson drew the remaining outside coverage (right 5.9 YPA, left 6.54) with Lenoir active. The 16.5 and 61.5 numbers are season medians for a reason: half the prior games sat at or under them, and a four-game heater can be the fluky stretch rather than the new baseline. That counter is real but not stronger than 35 and 15 targets plus a vacated 28-target WR, so the legs stay and get flagged, not cut.
